verdict.rationale: Unity's scripting API and editor extensibility let developers write custom event-driven code (e.g. callbacks, custom inspectors, command-line automation of build/launch workflows), which can be used to trigger actions on events, but the evidence never documents an actual declarative 'rules that trigger actions on events' system or AI-native automation trigger framework. Missing for 10: a documented rules/trigger engine (e.g. webhook-style or event-condition-action config), AI-specific automation hooks, and independent confirmation that non-scripted users can define such rules.
